These match the design packet identities. This is local-provider evidence only; no pin change or hosted qualification.

Implements the design packet: package-scoped TrialDeterminantInput (preparation, coordinates, explicit lambda with an atPreparationLambda constructor, factor, value/first/second lower bands; all shape, count, finite and factor size/bandwidth checks before numerical work; NaN padding ignored), TrialDeterminantNumerics (residual tol 1e-10, validated), TrialDeterminantAttempt(Either[TrialDeterminantError, TrialDeterminantJet], TrialDeterminantWork). U=A^-1M, U_p=-A^-1A_pU, U_pq=-A^-1(A_pqU+A_pU_q+A_qU_p) on the same accepted factor. Gale logDetJet for A, and for small B=M'U packed as a CxC full band. Explicit (p,q) remap from ScalaFIM row packing to Gale column packing. Max-column normalized backward residual vs the original A bands for every solve. No jitter, clamp or floor; no dense NxN/TxT matrix in production; no domain inverse. Stored U plus d U_p plus one reused pair buffer plus RHS and residual = (d+4)NC scratch.

Evidence (all via ROOT/run-sbt.py with the override as one argv):
- logs/trial-ml-helper-final.log (SHA-256 f9ab68525acc8e10ca874cec236c2a8e48effb12c7b788f8da283efb6e5b9118; meta 6cd98adf375f4a527b7d5dbc975222f467a9ad019152fbab77fd7299dd29cf2f; exit 0; 187.2 s; finished 05:27:41Z): fitJVM and fitJS testOnly TrialConstrainedLogDetJetSuite (9) + TrialConditionalSolveSuite (5) = 14/14 each; scalafimCompileAll 91 successes, 0 [warn]/[error] (-Werror, -Wunused:all, -Wvalue-discard).
- Actual numbers (printed in the log): Gaussian D 1.80061705523080 vs dense 1.80061705523080; Cascade D 0.0474885453214 vs dense (diff ~1e-15). FD errors (gradient, Hessian) are ~1.5e-6/1.2e-6 at h=2e-3 and 3.7e-7/3.8e-7 at h=1e-3 (O(h^2)). Cascade |H02-H11| = 0.0219, more than 1000x the oracle error. lambda 1e-6/1/1e4 all admitted, max residual ~1e-16, worst relative dense difference ~1e-11 at lambda=1e-6 (JS 7.8e-12).
- Planted bugs (logs/trial-ml-helper-mutantA.log, -mutantB.log): copying Gale packing without the remap fails 2/9; dropping one same-axis A_pU_p term fails 3/9. Source restored and re-verified by hash before the final run.
- Earlier r1 failed only the fixture-strength assertion: it was scaled by max(1,|H|) while Cascade |H| is ~0.02. I replaced it with separation > 1e-3 and > 1000x the FD error, and tightened the FD tolerances to 2e-5 absolute plus a >1.67x shrink per halving.
Not covered: criterion adapter, owner reference seam, executor wiring, the structural alpha=0 bypass (executor-owned), energy/score parity (packet stage 2) and nuisance-alias refusal. These are for later owners; no public ML, scientific or performance claim. The early ML refusal remains.
